breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that the equilibrium condition is that the sum of forces in the two bars equals the total applied load, combined with the compatibility condition of equal elongation. This implies load sharing based on relative axial stiffnesses (AE/L), not equal splitting. The incorrect instruction to split the load equally is not present.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states the compatibility condition that both bars undergo the same elongation, and asks to determine 'the common elongation of the two bars' — not the sum of the two elongations. The incorrect instruction to add the two bar elongations to get plate displacement is not repeated.
